{{recipe}} 
[[Category:Recipes using pork]]
[[Category:Baked recipes]] [[Category:Barbecue recipes]]

== Ingredients ==
* 1 slab of either baby back ribs, or St. Louis cut pork ribs
* [[Cookbook:Rib Rub|Rib Rub]]
* Untreated hickory wood chips
* Your favorite [[Cookbook:Barbecue Sauce|barbecue sauce]]

== Procedure ==
#Season ribs liberally with rib rub. Refrigerate overnight.
#The next day, place a good amount of hickory chips in the bottom of a roasting pan. Place a rack in the pan and place ribs on the rack.
#Cover with [[Cookbook:Aluminium Foil|aluminum foil]] and place in the middle of a 200 °F [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]]. Cook 6 hours for baby back ribs, and 8 hours for St. Louis cut ribs, changing chips as needed.
#[[Cookbook:Brush|Brush]] the side facing you liberally with sauce. Remove foil and place under a preheated [[Cookbook:Broiler|broiler]] until well browned. Serve warm.

== Warnings ==

* Keep a kitchen fan running while making this, and remember that even the best ventilation systems (at least the ones made for home use) will not work unless you keep a window open.
